images.role: player ship; palette reference for the set
images.prompt: Chunky 16-bit arcade pixel art sprite of one small, wide, calm spaceship seen from directly above, the house ship of a retro replay shooter. Cream hull (#e8e0c8) with pale blue-grey (#c8d0dc) accents and a darker slate shadow side. Hard pixel edges, flat colours, no gradients, no glow, no motion blur. A single sprite centered on a flat near-black (#101018) background with nothing else in frame. No letters, no numbers, no arrows, no symbols, no user interface, no text of any kind.
images.note: cream hull, slate accents, calm; reads at 128
